description: When the v4 fetcher drops a job because of its crawl history. replay-recorder-v4/src/history.rs repeats this rule to send no job that the fetcher drops, and the tests on both sides read these cases. Times are relative to the moment of the decision.

cases.name: a stored copy one day old
no stored copy, before the refetch time
a stored copy 1 ms younger than the refresh interval
a stored copy as old as the refresh interval
a stored copy at its refetch time
